build_PerspectiveHead: build a PerspectiveHead module to predict camera translation parameters s, tx, ty from pose tokens
create_PerspectiveHead_forward: create a forward pass through PerspectiveHead to predict camera parameters from decoder pose tokens
run_PerspectiveHead_perspective_projecti: run perspective_projection to reproject 3D keypoints to 2D image space using predicted camera translation

test_PerspectiveHead_perspective_project: test perspective_projection with 3D points and camera intrinsics to verify 2D reprojection output
